profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Engineer with 20 years experience in a multitude of engineering fields; primarily serving as a UI/UX and data API architect. Enjoys mentoring, leading, and breaking down complex challenges into consumable pieces that continuously burn down risk; fail early and often, while you iterate to a solution. Penchant for efficiency, both for the user and the developer.

http://resume.anthonymandra.com
https://github.com/rcketscientist

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager 3
positions.description:
Served as the lead UX/UI architect for a large Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR) project.
Led and mentored a small team into roles as subject matter experts in UI/UX best practices across the program.
positions.insights: Skills: Team Leadership · Devops · Risk Assessment · Scrum · Agile Project Management · Mentoring · C++ · Architectural Design · GUI · HMI Design · HTML · Human Machine Interface · Java · JavaScript · TypeScript · User Experience (UX) · User Interface Programming · Web Design · CSS · Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) · Git · REST APIs · gRPC · Protocol Buffers · Nginx · Representational State Transfer (REST) · Software Design · Schema · React · React.js · Node.js · Project Management · ISR

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed an Angular component library that was integrated in dozens of projects company-wide. Instantly improved buy-in to company branding and UX best practices while drastically reducing implementation time compared to fragmented legacy UI solutions.
Designed a plugin architecture that bypassed Angular framework to allow truly dynamic runtime loading of Angular libraries that are unknown at build-time.
Developed a web-based window manager system to orchestrate interaction and layout of custom Angular plugin system.
positions.insights: Skills: Angular · Angular CLI · Web Development · User Experience (UX) · GUI · Reactive Programming · Rx · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Node.js · Technology Leadership · Leading Development Teams · PostgreSQL · Angular Material

positions.title: Sr. Engineer
positions.description: Developed the first Android application capable of decoding and managing raw image formats from professional cameras.
positions.insights: Skills: Devops · Agile Project Management · GUI · Git · HMI Design · HTML · Human Machine Interface · Android · Android Development · Image Editing · Image Processing · Metadata Management · Metadata · Java · Kotlin · C++

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed a weather model that used predictions as well as live data to drive an autonomous mission planning algorithm.

positions.title: Engineer III
positions.description: Designed a high fidelity sensor model and mission management interface leveraged by operators of an unmanned vehicle in simulated missions to drive iterative design in the earliest stages of program development.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET Framework · Rapid Prototyping · Schema · Simulations · Sensors · Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) · Autonomous Routing
